physical_key.site: study-independent latitude and longitude rounded to five decimals
physical_key.frame: site plus valid calendar year and month
physical_key.event: nonempty SAMPLE_DESC only for declaring a location-month-year as genuinely sampled
physical_key.study: STUDY_ID kept only as a group label, never part of the cross-study physical-frame identity

definitions: containment=intersect/min(number of physical keys in study A, number in B)
frame near-duplicate if frame intersection >=10 and frame containment >=0.80 AND site containment >=0.80
shared geography if >=5 sites overlap and site containment >=0.80; warning even if time windows disjoint
same physical frame does not prove identical species data, shared study authors, survey effort, or detection process

separate_geometry_sufficiency.purpose: At least five distinct active matched-year sites needed to define an across-site configuration contrast

admission_rules.cross_pilot_reserved_near_duplicate: STOP separate-network holdout interpretation for the affected network; keep reserved taxa sealed
admission_rules.within_reserved_near_duplicate: Group studies in a single independent network block; no per-STUDY_ID pseudoreplication
admission_rules.cross_pilot_reserved_shared_geography_on: Flag higher-conservatism hold pending source-method provenance; do not automatically interpret as independent replicates

output_restriction.per_pair: only nonzero overlap or threshold positives; study IDs, shared site/year-month counts and ratios
output_restriction.graph: connected components for near-duplicate and shared-geography networks
